article_title: Fostering Self-Directed Growth with Generative AI: Toward a New Learning Analytics Framework
citation: Qianrun Mao. (2024). Fostering Self-Directed Growth with Generative AI: Toward a New Learning Analytics Framework. https://www.google.com/search?q=Fostering+Self-Directed+Growth+with+Generative+AI+Toward+a+New+Learning+Analytics+Framework
title: A2PL framework: three foundational pillars (Capacity to Aspire, Complex Thinking, Self-Assessment) reconfigured around Self-Directed Growth
description: The Aspire to Potentials for Learners framework reconfigures the three foundational pillars of SDL summarized by Morris (2019): "The Capacity to Aspire represents the core essence of humanistic philosophy; Complex Thinking serves as the foundation of constructivist epistemology; and Self-Assessment embodies the principles of pragmatic philosophy". At the center is Self-Directed Growth, and together the pillars represent a learning process that is individual, purposeful, and developmental. The framework aligns summative self-assessment with the two layers of Capacity to Aspire within and across learning cycles.
requirements: Summative self-assessment must be combined with Capacity to Aspire to drive an ongoing, iterative, and sustainable SDL process
constraints: The article states detailed technical implementations, platform engineering, and algorithmic design fall outside its scope and are reserved for future research
target_learners: learners in non-synchronous online learning environments

article_title: Fostering Self-Directed Growth with Generative AI: Toward a New Learning Analytics Framework
citation: Qianrun Mao. (2024). Fostering Self-Directed Growth with Generative AI: Toward a New Learning Analytics Framework. https://www.google.com/search?q=Fostering+Self-Directed+Growth+with+Generative+AI+Toward+a+New+Learning+Analytics+Framework
title: A2PL three-level intervention design: Person, Task, and Person x Task levels
description: The A2PL intervention operates at three levels. At the Person level, learners reflect on aspirations and long-term vision of societal achievement and professional growth. At the Task level, "Learners and GAI co-create complex thinking tasks within real world scenarios that align with learners' aspirations". At the Person x Task level, learners construct a summative self-assessment framework by aligning identified ability, skill, and strategy gaps with task-aligned personal aims, fostering a more clearly defined strategic learning pathway. Starting from the second round, reflective practices adjust alignment and initiate a new SDL cycle.
requirements: GAI must refrain from disclosing that the assessment pertains directly to SDL, so learners' frameworks indicate internalized skills rather than prompted responses
constraints: The article states success is contingent on whether learners' summative self-assessment frameworks reflect analytical cognition of SDL into the depth of its procedures and components
target_learners: self-paced learners in non-synchronous online environments
examples: Table 1 maps learning stages to theoretical guidelines, GAI features, and skills developed, including root-cause analysis for systemic thinking and scenario-based tasks for critical thinking and problem-solving

article_title: First graders' literacy and self-regulation gains: The effect of individualizing student instruction
citation: Connor Carol McDonald, Ponitz Claire Cameron, Phillips Beth M., Travis Q. Monét, Glasney Stephanie, Morrison Frederick J. (2010). First graders' literacy and self-regulation gains: The effect of individualizing student instruction. Journal of School Psychology. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jsp.2010.06.003
title: Assessment-to-instruction (A2i) web-based planning software
description: The Assessment-to-instruction (A2i) software "translates assessment results into specific recommendations for amounts and types of instruction for each student in the classroom". It automatically records teachers' use, including total minutes of active use, which the study used as a metric of planning and a proxy for intervention fidelity. An integral part of the ISI intervention, A2i includes planning-specific components such as the Literacy Minutes Manager and the Group Activity Planner, and is available at http://isi.fcrr.org.
requirements: Teachers must be trained to use the software to plan individualized instruction, and assessment results must be available to generate recommendations
constraints: A2i use minutes are a proxy for fidelity, not a direct measure of instructional quality; treatment teachers' use ranged widely, from 15 to 370 minutes
target_learning_goals: Individualized literacy instruction matched to students' vocabulary and reading skills
examples: Treatment teachers used A2i on average about 160 minutes from September through May; the ISI Treatment variable coded control teachers as 0 and treatment teachers by their A2i minutes
